name: Tiger Mastery
summary: Ajeck Rouack offers the ultimate challenge in his series of hunts within northern Stranglethorn Vale. After weeks of tracking an elusive beast, he challenges you to seek out the tiger Sin'Dall and bring back her paw.

sections.title: The Final Tiger
sections.body: Having completed the earlier trials against Stranglethorn's tigers, you are offered one last challenge by Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition. The hunting camp has tracked an extraordinarily elusive tiger known as Sin'Dall across the jungle for weeks. Ajeck challenges you to track her down, fell the beast, and claim her paw as indisputable proof.

sections.title: Master Tiger Hunter
sections.body: Returning to Nesingwary's camp with the paw of Sin'Dall proves your tracking prowess beyond question. Ajeck Rouack acknowledges your accomplishment, declaring you a true Master Tiger Hunter.

faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack, a seasoned huntsman stationed at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, presents this final feline challenge.
Sin'Dall is an elusive tiger that the hunters of Nesingwary's Expedition have been pursuing for weeks across the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What proof does Ajeck Rouack require?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack requires you to return with the Paw of Sin'Dall to prove that the beast was truly bested.
This hunt is the fourth and culminating step of Ajeck Rouack's series, following the third Tiger Mastery trial in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
